title: Spring Rolls
description: Crispy spring rolls filled with a delicious and refreshing vegan eggplant and cucumber filling. Perfect as a snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: spring rolls
ingredients.notes: usually found in the frozen food section

ingredients.name: eggplant
ingredients.notes: choose a firm and fresh eggplant

instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
Unwrap the spring rolls and cut them in half lengthwise.
In a small bowl, mix together the eggplant, cucumber, russian dressing, garlic, and soy sauce.
Stuff each spring roll with the eggplant mixture.
Fry the spring rolls in batches until they're golden brown and crispy.
Drain the spring rolls on paper towels and serve hot.
